title: Passenger vehicle dispatches rise 21.8% to 454K units in September: Siam
description:
Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches from companies to dealers rose 21.8 per cent year-on-year to 4,54,574 units in September this year, industry body SIAM said on Thursday.
The total passenger vehicle dispatches from automakers to dealers were at 3,73,347 units last September.
Total two-wheeler sales rose 13.5 per cent to 24.63 lakh units last month as against 21.70 lakh units in September last year, it added.
Three-wheeler dispatches to dealers were up 16 per cent last month at 98,162 units in September 2026 as against 84,635 units in the year-ago period, it added.
